description.summary: fill a text field only if it is still the one that was checked

protocol.description:
Lets a password manager put text into the focused text field (a zwp_text_input_v3) knowing who will get it.
An input method's commit_string goes to whichever text input is focused when the request arrives, so text meant for one app can reach another that took the focus in between. Here the client first takes a target: a snapshot of the focused text input, with who owns it as the compositor knows it (the process id from the client's socket and the executable that process runs, never anything the app said about itself). It then asks to fill that target; the compositor puts the text in only if the same text input of the same surface still has the keyboard, and drops it otherwise.
Only unrestricted clients (not run under a security context) can bind the manager.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Targets made with it are unaffected.

request.name: get_target
request.description: Makes a target for the text input that has the keyboard right now. The target's identity event follows at once.

description.summary: a focused text field, as it was when taken

entry.name: window
entry.summary: the field is in a toplevel window

entry.name: layer
entry.summary: the field is in a layer-shell surface

entry.name: sandboxed
entry.summary: the owner runs under a security context (a sandbox)

entry.name: text_input
entry.summary: the owner has an enabled text input; without it fill is refused

entry.name: unknown_credentials
entry.summary: the compositor could not learn the owner's process

entry.name: changed
entry.summary: another field, surface or app has the keyboard now

entry.name: no_text_input
entry.summary: the field takes no text input

entry.name: invalid_text
entry.summary: the text is empty, too long or holds control characters

event.name: identity
event.description: Sent once, right after the target is made. pid is 0 and exe empty when the owner's process is unknown. app_id is the window's app id (what the app says it is, so only a hint), empty for other surfaces. window_id is the window's id as niri's IPC gives it (high and low 32 bits), 0 for other surfaces.

request.name: fill

description.summary: put text in the field, if it is still the same

request.description: The compositor checks the same text input of the same surface has the keyboard, then commits the text to it as an input method would. A target is filled at most once and lives for two minutes. One filled or refused event answers.
